description: Local-first crew files: first-visit welcome card, own crew file with optional validated baseline, several files on one device with a switcher in the top bar, export / validated import / delete / reset demo, and 'building your baseline: N of 7 days' on young files
steps_to_verify: Clear site data and open the app: the demo boots, then a dismissible welcome card offers 'Explore the demo mission' and 'Start my own crew file'
Start my own crew file: empty name is refused, diastolic >= systolic is refused, baseline fields may stay empty
The new file opens on mission day 1 with no alerts and 'Building your baseline: 0 of 7 days'
Log a check-in with temperature 38.4: a Critical fever alert appears and the counter says 1 of 7 days
Press the crew name: both files are listed, Open switches, Export downloads one JSON, Import refuses an edited file with an impossible value and says nothing was imported

description: Sound synthesised in code with the Web Audio API (no audio files), off by default, speaker toggle in the top bar, choice remembered, paused when the tab is hidden: six-note motif, low pad with a pulse at today's resting heart rate, zone tick, zone-card tone, check-in chime, two-tone Critical annunciator played once and silenced by Acknowledge; Attention is silent
steps_to_verify: Open the app: the speaker button shows sound off and no AudioContext exists
Press the speaker: the motif plays, the pad starts, the choice is stored
Hover two zones: one soft tick each; open a zone: two-note tone; save a check-in: three-note chime
Reset the demo so the fever alert is new: the two-tone signal plays once; Acknowledge during it silences it
Hide the tab: audio is suspended; reload: sound is still on and starts on the first click
